blind.description: A thick, ornate fantasy spellbook or grimoire lying flat on the floor. It features a rich crimson-red leather cover with raised spine ribs, decorative golden corner protectors, a central oval golden medallion on the front cover, and a golden clasp closure on the opening side. Off-white parchment pages are visible around the closed block, and a small red ribbon bookmark extends from the bottom edge. All geometry is solid, clean, and styled with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From directly overhead, it appears as a rectangular crimson book cover adorned with four golden corner brackets and an oval gold medallion in the center, with spine segments visible along the bottom edge, a clasp on the top edge, and a small red ribbon protruding at the lower-right side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 6 inches thick (roughly 1/15th the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 1.2 feet wide across the cover.
